basedOn: 01-style/directions.json → decision.direction (Christopher's own: dark industrial electronica, Monolith ink art)

options.name: Load-Bearing
options.story: A lone keeper deep inside a megastructure is the wall everyone leans on without knowing. Tender, unthanked, steady.
options.hook: Load-bearing, load-bearing — I am the wall you lean on in the dark.
options.chorus: Ten thousand floors above my head / and every one of them asleep / I hum the cables, warm the steel / I keep the promise that I keep / Load-bearing, load-bearing / I don't need you to know my name / just lean a little on the dark / and I will hold you all the same

options.name: The Hundredth Dark
options.story: A descent through level after empty level, looking for the bottom of the structure, and of a feeling. Letting go as relief.
options.hook: Take me down to the hundredth dark.
options.chorus: Past the furnace, past the floodgate / past the rooms with no one in / every level colder, quieter / every door I close again / Take me down to the hundredth dark / where the last lamp never reached / if there's nothing at the bottom / I can finally stop and breathe
options.refrain: Down… and down… and down… and still.

options.name: Concrete Remembers
options.story: The building remembers everyone who ever passed through it. Ghosts held in architecture; nothing is lost, only stored.
options.chorus: You walked these halls a hundred years ago / your footsteps poured into the floor / the stone kept every word you said / it kept the shape of every door / The concrete remembers your weight / the girders remember your hand / everything you built is still awake / still waiting for you to stand
